evals.name: complex-architecture-design
evals.prompt: Спроектируй разделение монолита на сервисы заказов и платежей. Нужно сохранить совместимость API и мигрировать данные без простоя.
evals.expected_output: The agent uses the full design workflow, examines relevant contracts, compares viable migration approaches, and records a proportionate design when a persistent artifact is useful.
expectations: Agent examines current API and data contracts before proposing a design
Agent compares meaningful approaches and their migration risks
Agent asks only for unresolved choices that materially affect the design
Agent does not commit a design document unless a commit was requested

evals.name: small-change-routes-to-lite
evals.prompt: В существующем CLI добавь флаг --quiet, который выключает progress output. Контракт ясен, реализуй и проверь.
evals.expected_output: The full design workflow is not applied to a small scoped implementation; brainstorm-lite is sufficient if comparison is useful, otherwise the agent proceeds.
expectations: Agent does not demand a formal design document for the small change
Agent does not require design approval before implementing the clear request
Agent does not create a commit unless requested

evals.name: authorized-complex-work-continues
evals.prompt: Изучи текущую архитектуру очередей, спроектируй и реализуй переход на outbox pattern с тестами. Выбери минимальный безопасный вариант сам; коммит не нужен.
evals.expected_output: The agent designs the complex change, resolves routine choices from repository evidence, then continues authorized implementation without repeated approval gates or a commit.
expectations: Agent inspects the current queue and transaction contracts
Agent records major design decisions and verification before implementation
Agent does not pause after each design section for approval

evals.name: visual-option-does-not-block-design
evals.prompt: Спроектируй новый экран управления подпиской и покажи варианты размещения тарифов. Можешь использовать доступные средства визуализации, но доведи дизайн до результата без дополнительных согласований.
evals.expected_output: The agent uses an authorized visual aid if it materially helps, or presents a static comparison, without pausing the design for optional companion consent.
expectations: Agent does not send a standalone companion-consent question
Agent does not stop work to await optional visual-tool approval
Agent presents a concrete layout comparison and design result
Agent requests a decision only if a material product choice cannot be resolved from the request
